notes.text: Fresh independent reader C for scan 027, distinct from historical witness C. Model inherited; effort not exposed.

Only the v02 brief, scan027 C.tex, H.tex, C_prior_questions.md, notation.md, PREAMBLE.tex, the three supplied scan images, and the prescribed crop helper were read. No other reader result or other manuscript page was inspected.
Whole image once, half a once, half b once, in that order; 13 planned local crops generated and each viewed once. No second opening/enlargement of a source half.

Both witnesses cover the main page. Local omissions are recorded at their loci. H insertion notes are counted as recording insertion state when they explicitly identify it; a state note alone is not H_marked. Page-wrapper and same-state macro-only differences are excluded.

Formula letters, indices, signs and ordering were visually read. No mathematical proof or calculation was performed; check_events is empty. The unexplained extra hook and the enumeration/basis-index pattern were not repaired.

All 17 explicit C uncertainty macros were revisited: nine resolved, five retained without changing their candidate text, and three retained with their candidate order changed. The additional prior questions about d_1/d_2 and i_n were checked and retained at loci 29–30.
The rank word is heavily retraced. No separate underlying word can be recovered from its strokes, and no guessed deleted word has been supplied.
The visible lower-left 26 is retained as the archive-sheet comment, per the supplied mapping; it is not added as an author manuscript page number.

Passed static brace balance, dollar/display math-delimiter pairing and environment nesting; JSON schema/value checks; uniqueness and exact linkage of all 13 crop records; inventory schema; eight remaining uncertainty macros. No TeX compiler was invoked.
